overview_description.description:
Chaser helps businesses get their invoices paid on time, automatically. They're solving the twin problems of late payment and the time it has previously taken to chase customers.

Chaser is a platform that is reimagining how this chasing is carried out. A business can use their web application to apply rules based automation to chasing their customers via email. They can do so intelligently, powered by the behavioural analytics from their proprietary email handling and logging software.

product.name: Accounts Receivable Automation Software
product.description: Software that automates the process of chasing and collecting late invoice payments, tracking debtors, and managing accounts receivable.

product.name: Accounts Receivable Insights and Resources
product.description: A collection of guides, templates, videos, and tools to help businesses reduce late payments and improve accounts receivable processes.

product.name: Accounts Receivable Support and Services
product.description: Expert assistance to set up, review, and optimize credit control processes and accounts receivable management.

product.name: Auto-call Feature
product.description: An automated calling system that uses text-to-speech technology to deliver pre-scripted payment reminders to debtors.

product.name: Debt Collections Services
product.description: A service to recover overdue payments on a no-win no-fee basis while maintaining customer relationships.

product.name: Revenue Forecasting
product.description: A tool to predict future revenue and improve financial planning through automated and customizable forecasts.
